faq.a: No. All 6 versions of ByteDance Seed in the OpenRouter catalog are served over APIs only, with no open weights. The developer does publish open-weight repositories under the Seed name on Hugging Face, the most downloaded being ByteDance-Seed/Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct. The family's repositories on Hugging Face declare the Apache 2.0 licence, and some carry a custom licence set out on the model card.

Through the OpenRouter catalog, ByteDance Seed costs from $0.08 to $0.5 per million input tokens and from $0.3 to $3 per million output tokens, depending on the version. The cheapest is Seed 1.6 Flash.

paragraphs: ByteDance Seed is the developer of the ByteDance Seed model family, which the pages describe as a family of foundation models and GenMedia models. ByteDance Seed says the Seed model family has always been committed to uncovering users' real needs and unlocking their creativity. The family includes Seed2.1, a generation of agent-capable models built for real-world productivity, designed to solve complex needs across daily life, professional work, and frontier exploration. Seed2.1 follows Seed2.0, and ByteDance Seed says Doubao and Volcano Engine users can now start to access Doubao Seed 2.1.

The family also includes Seedance 2.5, a new-generation video creation model that follows Seedance 2.0, and Seed Audio 1.0, an audio creation model that generates speech, sound effects, ambience, and other scene-level audio elements within one unified framework. SeedRealtime is a native audio-visual full-duplex LLM. Other models named on the pages include Seedream 5.0 Pro, Seeduplex, and Seed GR-RL. ByteDance Seed offers these models through platforms including Doubao, Volcano Engine, BytePlus, Jimeng AI, Doubao Pro, and BytePlus ModelArk, and also provides a Playground.

price_limits.summary: Across the 6 versions, input prices run from $0.08 to $0.5 per million tokens and output prices from $0.3 to $3. Seed 1.6 Flash is the cheapest, at $0.08 per million input tokens and $0.3 per million output tokens. Seed 2.1 Turbo has the largest context window, 262,144 tokens.

items.claim: ByteDance describes Seed2.1 as its language and reasoning model family for real-world productivity, with gains in general agents and code engineering, offered in two models.
Seedance 2.5, introduced on 31 July 2026, is ByteDance Seed's video model, built for 30-second single-take storytelling with precise reference control and editing.
Seedream 5.0 Pro, introduced on 8 July 2026, is ByteDance Seed's image generation model, described as combining reasoning with design understanding.
SeedRealtime is a full-duplex model that jointly understands sound, vision and timing so it can listen, watch and speak at once; ByteDance released its audio-visual full-duplex LLM on 5 August 2026.
Seed Audio 1.0 generates full-scene audio end to end, aimed at film-grade sound creation.

ByteDance Seed's robotics line includes GR-3, a vision-language-action model for long-horizon dexterous tasks, and GR-RL, a reinforcement learning framework for multi-step, high-precision manipulation.
Outside China, ByteDance sells Seed models to developers through BytePlus ModelArk, whose documentation covers Seedance video, Seedream image, multimodal embedding and tool use including remote MCP.

family_reading.text: ByteDance Seed's Seed line offers six API-only versions, all with reasoning support and none with open weights, so self-hosting is not an option. Every version carries a 262144 token context window, though maximum output varies widely, from 32768 tokens on the two Seed 1.6 releases up to 235929 on Seed 2.1 Turbo. Inputs can include image, text and video, with text-only output. Pricing spans a broad range, from $0.08 per million input and $0.3 output on Seed 1.6 Flash to $0.5 input and $2.5 output on Seed 2.1 Turbo, with Seed-2.0-Code at $3 output. The facts suggest the family suits long-context multimodal work and reasoning tasks where an API is acceptable, with cheaper tiers for high-volume use. Limits include the absence of open weights, the cost of the larger output tiers, and the smaller output ceiling on the 1.6 versions.
